dedupe_keys.name: convlstm based daily snow water equivalent swe predictions in the norway

description: The STARS4Water team deposits two daily snow-water-equivalent NetCDFs for Norway, comparing ConvLSTM estimates driven by ERA5 with a SeNorge-based series. The page describes a 1 km resolution and filenames spanning 2017 to 2023. Both public files are approximately 9.6 GB each and Zenodo labels the release CC BY 4.0. A Norwegian runoff or hydropower simulation could use these snow-storage grids as alternative forcing or a comparison target. The values are model-based and should not be treated as direct field observations. The filenames include `0p045deg`, which does not transparently match the page's 1 km claim; the actual grid must be checked inside the NetCDF. The own page also omits units, uncertainty and the exact relationship between the ConvLSTM and SeNorge series. No archive was downloaded and no grid was inspected. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this Norway release.
name: ConvLSTM-based Daily Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) Predictions in the Norway
